description: Enforced rule catalog; changes require review and updated canaries.

node_ssrf.reason: This legacy CJS Express-request SSRF model applies to server/shared/build code, not browser React components. Native-fetch taint remains selected across all application JS/TS. A server-scoped upstream SSRF canary is required.

excluded_upstream_rules.regex_dos: Audit prompt matching almost any regular expression use; does not identify a catastrophic regex. Keep specific regex_injection_dos enforced and review actual regex complexity manually.
excluded_upstream_rules.node_timing_attack: Generic string comparison audit prompt. The initial hit compares nonsecret action-request receipt fingerprints for replay consistency (moderation-service), not authentication secrets. Secret comparisons remain subject to code review and authentication tests.
excluded_upstream_rules.node_insecure_random_generator: Treats every Math.random call as a security finding. Current use is a nonsecret UI room-slug suffix; the server authorizes room creation independently. Dedicated pseudoRandomBytes prohibition is supplied locally; security token randomness requires manual review.
excluded_upstream_rules.node_username: Matches ordinary string constants containing user in their variable name, including a browser settings storage key. Not evidence of embedded credentials. Gitleaks and upstream hardcoded password/key/secret rules remain enforced.
excluded_upstream_rules.express_xss: Legacy broad metavariable pattern times out on large React components. Replaced by request-to-HTML taint, DOM-XSS and React unsafe-HTML rules; engine timeouts on every selected rule still fail the gate.
